answer: An operator holds one licensed marble breast-roll on a paper machine. Only that holder may lace a uniquely serialled sable wire into the dandy roll and, in a published headbox window, lift a one-shot wet sheet whose laid ripple must match the official consistency trace. Graders match the roll lease, wire serial, watermark, and headbox log. A shared roll, a reused wire, or an off-window sheet is slashed as one farm. N aliases cost N exclusive rolls, N unique wires, and N live headbox windows no single tender can staff at once.
